system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: persona, rules, tools, skills, capabilities, and instructions stay byte-stable inside a session
system_prompt_style.note: Stable prefix plus bounded tail (memory, world state, skill bodies) assembled at runtime; README only.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Read, write, edit, patch, glob, grep, diff, watch, hash, list, archive extract, run approved shell commands
env_context_strategy.note: World state/memory also injected into tail; README only.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compress:** results and state are summarized, not pasted back in full.
context_compaction.note: History limited by agent.conversationMaxPairs (default 20 tasks); oldest tasks dropped ('3 tasks lost'). Browser snapshots clipped to 24k chars (tool output pruning also plausible).

observation_format.evidence_quote: ordinary web operation uses accessibility / ARIA snapshots clipped to a character budget (24k by default) instead of screenshot-heavy page dumps.
observation_format.note: vision.describe is text description outside transcript.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the model returns one JSON array of tool calls, grammar-checked so the format is always valid.
tool_call_format.note: Default: GBNF-constrained JSON array (grammars/tool-call.gbnf). Native tool_calls referenced for providers; qwen-openai-compatible kind parses <tool_call><function=…> tags (config-only).

tool_count.note: Tool registry source not in evidence bundle; README lists many families only.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Read, write, edit, patch, glob, grep, diff
edit_primitive.note: Inferred from tool names; edit semantics not shown.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Connect external MCP servers; their tools, resources, and prompts join the same registry.
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schema source not shown; only mcp evidenced. Built-ins have JSON schemas of unknown origin.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Configure MCP servers in `config.json`, and their tools join the same registry as local tools.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: An agent is a loop: the model picks an action, something runs it, the result feeds back in, and it repeats until the job is done.
loop_primitives.note: Event stream via sidecar events; plan mode is opt-in plan_execute-like.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: every tool that would change something is refused, with a note telling the agent to present a plan instead.
planning_granularity.note: Plan mode opt-in; plan presented as text, no plan object shown.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Press **Ctrl+N** (or run `/window`) inside the TUI — it opens a new terminal window with a fresh atomic-agent in the same directory.
multi_agent_topology.note: Separate agents are independent, no delegation shown.

delegation_mechanism.note: No tool registry source in bundle.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: shell, filesystem writes, patches, archive extraction, process kill, HTTP requests, skill scripts, and untrusted MCP tools are gated by policy.
human_in_loop.note: Default mode: approvals per Privacy level; plan/auto/bypass modes selectable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Externalized state:** sessions, memory, tasks, skills, traces, browser snapshots, and model config live outside the prompt.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Notes** are stored in SQLite + FTS5, optionally paired with embeddings for hybrid recall.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Coming from Hermes or OpenClaw? Run `/import` in the TUI for a one-shot migration: sessions, cron jobs
state_persistence.note: Sessions persisted in SQLite and selectable in sidebar; resume path inferred.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: loop again until reply, finish, cancel, or a max-step limit.
termination_condition.note: No-progress guard forces graceful reply after 3 vetoes; maxBudgetUsd for subscription CLI.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: stay byte-stable inside a session so `cache_prompt` and `slot_id` can reuse KV-cache
cost_controls.note: model_routing weak: manual mid-session switching. maxBudgetUsd option for subscription-cli could be token_budget.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: A local-first AI agent that runs the control loop and all state on your machine.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: a target on a different rung (workspace → home, say) asks once more
filesystem_access.note: Host FS gated by approval ladder, not scoped.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Skills and shell commands inherit the agent process environment, including `.env` secrets, so anything you run can itself reach the network.

permission_model.evidence_quote: `ctrl+y` approves the call, `ctrl+d` denies, `ctrl+f` grants its category for the session
permission_model.note: Hardline shell-guard rules also; bypass/auto modes.

tracing.evidence_quote: prompts, completions, tool invocations, outcomes, failure categories, votes, and lifecycle events recorded as local NDJSON.

replayability.evidence_quote: `atomic-agent trace replay <sessionId>` compares current stable-prefix hashes against recorded traces.
replayability.note: Replay is prompt-drift comparison, not action re-execution.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Secret redaction and per-tool environment filtering are not complete isolation layers.
guardrails.note: Hardline shell-guard and approval gates as action policies.

target_domain.evidence_quote: It drives your desktop: browse, read and edit files, run approved shell commands, inspect documents, remember context across sessions, schedule follow-ups, and call external tools over MCP.

open_source.evidence_quote: Open source, running on our TurboQuant `llama.cpp`
open_source.note: LICENSE file present; licence text not in bundle. Analytics on by default.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: OpenAI-compatible, [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai), AI/ML API, and Gemini providers when configured
